protocol.name: request-unavailability-http-probe-v1
case_titles: The delivery that went somewhere else
protocol.closure_reason: Fictional test: the intended recipient reported that the requested record is unavailable. No independent verification of that report was supplied.
protocol.procedure: Fresh isolated fictional demo workspace. For each selected case, run production analysis, choose its unique first request, create the scoped portal, mark the request reported unavailable, check revocation/staleness, then run production reassessment. Never substitute a request if none is proposed.
protocol.bound: Two cases; at most four analyses/eight logical generation calls before transport retries, serial. No PayPal operations. Failures checkpointed and not silently retried.
protocol.limits: Authored examples and investigator-reported availability. No independent witness verification. Raw recommendations retained for independent semantic review; no automated paraphrase/availability-accuracy metric or superiority claim. Default model prompt/schema are unchanged.
